source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of making halogenoarenes (PDF 84).

blocks.text: Chlorobenzene aur bromobenzene jaise halogenoarenes benzene ko chlorine ya bromine se, khushk FeCl3 ya FeBr3 catalyst ki maujoodgi mein, aam taur par kamre ke darja hararat par react kara kar banaye jate hain. Yeh reaction electrophilic aromatic substitution hai: C6H6 + X2 -> C6H5X + HX.

blocks.prompt: Benzene se chlorobenzene kis qism ke reaction se banta hai?
blocks.explanation: Electrophilic aromatic substitution, Cl2 aur FeCl3 catalyst ke saath.

items: Benzene + Cl2 ya Br2, FeX3 ke saath, halogenoarene + HX (electrophilic substitution).
